preregistration.source_definition_provenance: R1_CONSUMER_CONTRACT_20260917 section6 S0; Host defines compact monochromatic verification experiment prospectively, not an observed/stellar SED

units.source: photons per H nucleus per proper second

constants.threshold_rounding_policy: Keep actual FT03 HHeModel binding chi and Verner fit cutoff separately. Same absorption event uses provider sigma(E) with Verner cutoff and thermal/binding chi; do not change provider fits or silently equate authorities. Split/monitor both boundaries.

redshift.interpretation: Prescribed background label only; no Friedmann fit or cosmic initial history

initial_state.photon_angular_distribution: ISOTROPIC_CONTINUUM_MEASURE; positive quadrature is a declared numerical approximation
initial_state.provenance: Prospective deterministic verification IC; not inherited NodeHistory or REC history

source.paired_source_ownership: Identical isotropic proper matter-frame emissivity per nucleus and initial realization; geometry maps directions/energies separately
source.birth_rule: Record actual birth time, E_birth and direction; q_i=a_i(t_birth)*E_birth*e_i conserved between interactions; do not redshift twice
source.time_discretization: Accepted-stage endpoint emissivity with actual substep time/weight; record discretization error; source quadrature shared between paired runs

spectral.edge_interpretation: Support window10..20eV. Split active HI binding and actual Verner cutoff separately. He binding/fit thresholds are inactive metadata above support; no extended Emax or invented tails. Evaluate actual sigma(E) and binding separately at each stage.
spectral.source_tail_bound_basis: Exact Dirac monoenergy support13.7eV is inside[10,20]; source outside-window integrals identically0 by definition, not a fitted physical SED approximation

atomic_model.rate_source: FT03 source-to-model equations; existing ft03_rates.rs analytic HG RR/CI and two Grackle highT DR capture terms
atomic_model.recombination_emission: ESCAPING_ENERGY_LEDGER; no diffuse reabsorption or inferred ionizing photon count
atomic_model.thermal_processes: Primary photoheat, CI threshold sink, HG derivative RR kinetic moment, pinned2 DR energy terms only
atomic_model.optional_HH_direct: OFF; no HH uncertainty certificate assumed
atomic_model.optional_He_RCT: OFF; new opt-in provider not activated
atomic_model.physical_fit_uncertainty: NOT_MEASURED; deterministic fit defines mathematical model, not zero physical error
atomic_model.omitted_cooling_and_model_error: NOT_MEASURED; no physical temperature/Universe accuracy claim
atomic_model.guard_policy: Reject/out-of-domain receipt; no clipping or silent fallback. Range is prescribed acceptance domain, not yet proven invariant.

secondary.screening: Maximum birth photoelectron excess from HI ~0.1015654eV, no He photoionization at13.7eV. Nonnegative H_i only redshift photons thereafter. This soft-photon screen is not a measured materiality bound for the full gas model.
secondary.extension_trigger: Any changed hard SED/source, blueshift or requested quantitative secondary physical claim requires external validated MICRO1 deposition; no ad hoc fractions

numerics.photon_expansion_rule: Packet comoving counts, characteristicE; chemistry normalized per actual stage nH; no extra -3H in perH photon variable

outputs.filling_QV: NOT_EVALUABLE_WITHOUT_INDEPENDENT_PHASE_GEOMETRY; do not relabel homogeneous ionization fraction
